title: Poland Residence Permit Wait Times: Official Voivodeship Office Data
description: Official residence-permit processing times (average days, not medians), application counts and pending cases from Polish voivodeship offices. Expat Essentials Poland obtained the figures through public-information requests sent on 2026-10-07. Each row cites the office letter reference. Live tracker: app.expatessentials.pl/wait-times. Publisher: expatessentials.pl.
